name: ISU Chemical Co., Ltd
summary: ISU Chemical Co., Ltd., a company primarily engaged in the production and distribution of petrochemicals and fine chemicals, operates mainly within South Korea. Its comprehensive product line features items such as linear alkyl benzene, NP, branched alkyl benzene, specialized functional solutions, TAB, LAS, parasol, TDM, NaSH, and IPA. Founded in 1960, its principal office is located in Seoul, South Korea.
